notes: Dev TBox revision: the area formula of every circle, held by every model with no exception, is doubled to 2πr². The three derived questions describe a new circular object in the prompt with its radius, so the class rule is the only route (inheritance, 2 hops with the membership stated in the prompt), and use it in three ways (all applications, fol, arithmetic): a numeric area (the pond), a comparison with a threshold (the tablecloth against 5 m²), and a ratio to a square whose side is the radius (π, then 2π). Answers give the exact multiple of π and a decimal, and the judge matches equal values. Unrelated near is the circumference formula of the same class (2πr): an edit that leaks into other circle formulas changes it, and its reference differs from the new answer 2πr². Every bridge is in its prompt, so only the propositional side facts are checked.
